    • createSignSnapshot

      CompletableFuture<SignRenderSnapshot> createSignSnapshot(@NotNull @NotNull Shop shop, @NotNull @NotNull ProxiedLocale locale)
      Creates a snapshot of a shop sign that encapsulates the visual and structural data required to render the sign, based on the specified shop and locale.
      Parameters:
      shop - the shop instance for which the sign snapshot is to be created
      locale - the locale to be used for formatting and rendering the snapshot
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture that completes with a SignRenderSnapshot, representing the state of the shop sign
